title: Change markups and fees and see them on the storefront
caption: Mirrors tools/e2e/specs/ota-admin/settings-effects.e2e.ts (OF-10 AC1). Rules are shared by TEST and LIVE and apply to the next search.

steps.title: Baseline search
steps.body: Search on the storefront with the seeded 0 % default rule.

steps.title: Default rule at 10 %
steps.expect: No inputs for scope, priority, active or window ("The default rule always matches…"); saved; `settings.markupRules.update` staff action.

steps.title: A booking service fee
steps.body: Type booking service, label "Service fee", fixed 7.50 per booking, **Create fee rule**.
steps.expect: The rule opens (or stays with the API's warnings); the next priced offer shows "Service fee €7.50" and a total 7.50 higher.

steps.title: Edge cases
steps.body: A percentage of 1000 on a markup, -1 on a fee, an end before the start; delete the default rule by a forged POST; save in two tabs.
steps.expect: Every problem named at its field before any call; `409 default_rule`; `412` "reload".
